name: Miyashita Love
source: Their parents named her and her brother after the motto "love&peace", which is why her name is written with the Kanji "Ai" but read as "Love". Because she is embarassed about the name, she forces everyone to call her Ai instead. Together with Yoru she is best friends with Chiho, albeit being in a different class, and often helps out saving/straightening out Chiho when she goes berserk or clumsily tilts over, nearly causing her to fall down.
